peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Below peers (10.7): 1.4 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 26 of 266 similar developments with a figure (the same as 5). Context, not scored: resales in 4.2% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: The first resale wave ended before the observation period: sustained activity is the observed activity. First resale wave from Sep 2022 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date).

wave.basisLabel: analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Woodleigh MRT about 730 m, Lorong Chuan MRT about 800 m; closer than 127 of 462 similar developments (the same as 7). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 2 within 1 km and 9 within 2 km; nearest Yangzheng Primary School about 540 m; more than 242 of 462 similar developments (the same as 97). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 2 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 970 m), more than 56 of 462 similar developments (the same as 149); nearest hawker centre Woodleigh Village Hawker Centre about 820 m; nearest park Bidadari Park Hillock about 700 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 2 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (Chuan Park, 115 new sales, about 890 m; The Orie, 25 new sales, about 1,880 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 131 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 140 new sales and 737 resales (877 purchases); new sales were 16% of these purchases. Subsales (33) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: One Chuan Grove (government land sale site, awarded, about 1,060 homes), about 1,010 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 737 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 272 of 462 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 737 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 870 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−15.3%). Planning-area private resales −15.2%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
